question: Does AMDM's extra J1 gain over fixed delta=0.1 MDM weaken at n=30 and n=50?

selector.input: sorted(sample)/sample mean; no padding, masks or parameters
selector.target: 26 joint squared standardized parameter losses; invalid candidate filled by p99 valid loss from both n development sets
selector.scaling: per-position input and per-delta target StandardScaler fitted on full development set of each n
selector.mlp: scikit-learn MLPRegressor (256,128,64), ReLU, Adam, alpha=1e-4, learning_rate_init=1e-3, batch_size=256, max_iter=300, early_stopping=true, validation_fraction=.15, n_iter_no_change=20
selector.selection: inverse target scaling; clip predicted losses below zero; argmin, first delta on ties

primary: 1 - J1(AMDM)/J1(MDM-0.1), both valid paired observations; 2000 paired resamples within each test cell
secondary: Beta/eta/gamma Bias, SD, RMSE and failure rates; MLE-relative parameter RMSE on four-method jointly valid observations
bounds: No n=100, MM, new fixed-offset search, manuscript edits, or claim threshold
